title: Clucky’s new alarm app wakes you up with a crowing rooster
summary: Clucky's new alarm app has an option where users are woken up to the sound of a rooster. They then complete a mission to turn it off.
llm_summary: Clucky’s latest alarm app lets users start their day to the authentic crow of a rooster, but turning it off isn’t a simple tap. Instead, the app challenges you with a short “mission”—a quick puzzle or task—to ensure you’re fully awake before the alarm can be silenced. The feature blends classic wake‑up sounds with gamified interaction, aiming to make mornings both more effective and a bit more fun.
